dish.n: Yellow coat cheese and pineapple sticks
dish.note: Cubes of sharp cheddar and pineapple on toothpicks, a 1930s club tray.
dish.how: Cut 250g sharp cheddar into 2cm cubes and drain a 440g tin of pineapple pieces well. Thread a cube of cheese and a piece of pineapple onto each toothpick and stand them in half a grapefruit or lay them on a platter. Chill until serving.
dish.make_ahead: Thread up to 4 hours ahead and keep covered in the fridge

steps.text: Cut the cheddar into 2cm cubes and drain the pineapple well.
Thread a cube of cheese and a piece of pineapple onto each toothpick.
Stand them in the grapefruit half and chill until serving.
